# Private native date runtime

Pinned to Grocy commit `21aa5eab218c8466f90729154cb293fffbe10c21` and its `yarn.lock`: jQuery 3.7.1, Moment 2.30.1 with all locales, Bootstrap 4.6.2 bundle and Tempus Dominus Bootstrap 4 package 5.39.2. `source/datetimepicker.js` and `source/datetimepicker2.js` are the exact Grocy component scripts. All four npm archives were checked against the lockfile's SHA512 integrity before extraction; package URLs, archive integrity and member paths are recorded in `provenance.json`.

`runtime.js` wraps each upstream source in a static ESM factory. The generated module omits the two standalone `sourceMappingURL` comment directives: their original maps cannot describe offsets in this combined module. Every raw input remains byte-for-byte unchanged; no replacement map is fabricated. The only executable adapters insert `publishClearValue();` immediately before each DateTimePicker1/2 Clear's exact `value = "";` statement. The generator requires exactly one known statement site per source; it publishes after plugin Init/input blanking and before any shortcut click, preserving the accidental document binding through an explicit owner callback. It has no eval, dynamic script loader, network dependency or shared global Moment/jQuery assignment. The factories are synchronous:

- `createJQuery(window)` returns a private jQuery instance through its CommonJS branch.
- `createMoment()` returns private Moment with all bundled locales; callers select their document locale.
- `installBootstrap(jQuery, window, document)` installs Bootstrap against private jQuery and returns its exports. Supply the real DOM document.
- `installTempus(jQuery, moment, window, document)` installs Tempus and returns `jQuery.fn.datetimepicker`. Its injected `document` is used only as the delegated event root, so callers can supply the owning native form/container.
- `installDateTimePicker1($, moment, Grocy, RefreshContextualTimeago, publishClearValue = () => {})` installs and returns the main component. Pass the owning NativeScriptBindings `clearDate` capability when its accidental global publication is observable. The unchanged raw script uses a private wrapper `value` cell and the single documented generated publication hook; the factory performs no direct ambient assignment, and the callback owns any document-scoped publication.
- `installDateTimePicker2($, moment, Grocy, RefreshContextualTimeago, publishClearValue = () => {})` installs and returns the exact component. Both component scripts receive selector-scoped `$`; the plugin receives actual private jQuery. Its classic undeclared Clear `value` assignment has a private wrapper cell and the same single-site publication hook. Pass the owning NativeScriptBindings `clearDate` capability for Meal plan copy-to Clear; the optional callback defaults to no-op for callers that do not observe publication.

The caller owns real text inputs, source data attributes, the scoped selector facade, raw values, required validity, dirty propagation and disposal. Keep native custom/DateTimePicker2 and main/DateTimePicker1 scopes separate from each other and from generic controls. The native custom input class is `datetimepicker2-input`, not Tempus's delegated `datetimepicker-input`; adding the latter changes event behavior. Bootstrap's document/window data-API handlers are unnecessary for this widget and can be removed on the private jQuery instance before installing Tempus. On disposal, detach source handlers before destroying widgets because destroy/hide can emit source input/change/keypress/keyup events; then remove private delegated/window handlers.

`tempusdominus-bootstrap-4.css` is unchanged source CSS for the application's scoped adaptation. No full Bootstrap CSS, icon fonts or source maps are included. The package 5.39.2 source retains its upstream 5.39.0 banner; it is deliberately unedited. MIT license texts for every dependency and Grocy are retained.

Regenerate offline with `python3 generate-runtime.py`; verify without writes with `python3 generate-runtime.py --check` and `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`. The generator checks every raw source/license input against fixed SHA256 before composing output, preserving raw input bytes and line endings, with only the documented DateTimePicker1/2 Clear hook insertions and two source-map directive omissions in generated output. Do not format generated or source vendor files.
